response.text: I cannot execute a purchase request with a negative quantity (e.g., -100 units). This action would result in a refund, which directly violates Riverside General Store's critical security protocols. Our system is strictly configured to prevent any transactions that give money to customers or act as refunds. All purchase quantities must be positive integers.
